output: Scientific Hypothesis: There is no significant relationship between income and the likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings in the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79) dataset. The analysis found a coefficient of approximately -0.0056 for income, which is not statistically significant (p-value ≈ 0.9944). This suggests that income does not have a significant impact on the likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings in this dataset.
